spanish_stress: Derived from orthographic accent/default stress only when orthographic nuclei align with IPA vowels; ambiguous forms excluded. Separate source pronunciations from Latin America and Spain are retained; not dialect-universal.

emociones.reason: Common inflection absent from pinned WikiPron profiles; two attested standard readings retained.

caminó.reason: Attested verb inflection absent from pinned profiles; stress contrast must be tested with both words present.

publicó.reason: Attested verb inflection absent from pinned profiles; stress contrast must be tested with both words present.

terminó.reason: Attested verb inflection absent from pinned profiles; stress contrast must be tested with both words present.

peur.reason: Lexique 4.10 source pøʁ differs from cited dictionary reading; only this explicit form corrected.

french: Lexique word pronunciations; no automatic liaison, optional poetic schwa or Québec coverage.
review: Source and automated linguistic checks; independent native-speaker acceptance pending.

spanish_ranking.name: wordfreq
spanish_ranking.attribution: Robyn Speer (2022), wordfreq; underlying corpus contributors credited in WORDFREQ-NOTICE.md.
spanish_ranking.changes: Frequency estimates joined to existing Spanish pronunciation entries by word using the wordfreq API. Missing estimates remain zero; no entries removed.
spanish_ranking.limits: General-language usage through about 2021, not song lyrics, search demand, dialect-specific popularity or native editorial acceptance.
